newsitem.title: MEXICO: Accel looks plans expansion - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Accel looks plans expansion - CEO.

text.p: Holding company Accel SA is looking into alternatives to speed up expansion in its various divisions, the company CEO told Reuters on Friday.
"We are looking at alternatives that would allow us to grow swiftly in each of our divisions," Accel CEO Jesus Alvarez Morodo said in an interview.
Accel is a holding company for warehousing firms and apparel manufactureres.

Alvarez said that financial strength in its Elamex division may be used to fund expansion. Elamex floated $40 million of stock in the Nasdaq market in February, of which Accel used $18 million to pay off debts.
One project Alvarez mentioned was a new $10 million plant for Accel's Tropical Garment division, which would increase the firm's capacity to cut and sew clothing fourfold.
